name: Hotel Arts Barcelona
insider_take: Rising 44 stories above Barcelona's Olympic Village, Hotel Arts isn't just a hotel — it's a landmark. This iconic Ritz-Carlton tower has defined Barcelona's skyline since the 1992 Olympics and remains the city's ultimate address for luxury by the sea.
whats_special: One of only two skyscrapers permitted on Barcelona's waterfront, making it instantly recognizable across the entire city Home to Enoteca Paco Pérez , a two-Michelin-starred restaurant helmed by one of Catalonia's most celebrated chefs The hotel's Frank Gehry Fish sculpture — a gleaming copper landmark — sits just steps away on the Barceloneta beachfront Managed under Marriott's exclusive STARS & Luminous program, ensuring elite Ritz-Carlton service standards
pro_tip: Request a high-floor room facing the Mediterranean — sunrises over the sea from this vantage point are absolutely unforgettable, and you'll have Barceloneta Beach practically at your doorstep the moment you step outside.
dont_miss: Pool & Beach Club — The stunning outdoor pool deck overlooks the Mediterranean and is one of Barcelona's most coveted social scenes Arts Spa — A world-class wellness sanctuary offering treatments inspired by Catalan traditions Passeig de Gràcia — Just minutes away, stroll the grand boulevard to take in Gaudí's Casa Batlló and La Pedrera El Born & Gothic Quarter — Two of Barcelona's most atmospheric neighborhoods are easily walkable from the hotel
pros: Iconic oceanfront location with stunning Mediterranean views
Prime beachfront position in Barcelona's Port Olímpic
cons: Distance from historic city center attractions
